sloka: येन पूर्वं जनस्थाने बहवो ऽतिबला हताः।राक्षसा राघवं तं त्वं कथमेको जयिष्यसि ।। ६.६४.१२ ।।
transliteration: yena pūrvaṁ janasthāne bahavo 'tibalā hatāḥ।rākṣasā rāghavaṁ taṁ tvaṁ kathameko jayiṣyasi ।। 6.64.12 ।।

translations.english: "How is it possible for you single handed to win Raghava of exceeding might, who killed many Rakshasas in the past at Janasthana?"
